title: The Borrowed Harbor
author: Ansel Marchetti
blurb: Casper Winterbourne, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
